sanskrit_verse: न पुत्रऋणं पिता दद्याद् दद्यात् पुत्रस्तु पैतृकम् कामक्रोधसुराद्यूत प्रातिभाव्यकृतं विना
transliteration: na putraṛṇaṃ pitā dadyād dadyāt putrastu paitṛkam kāmakrodhasurādyūta prātibhāvyakṛtaṃ vinā
sph_interpretive_translation: The father does not bear the debt of the son; rather, the son bears the paternal debt, except in cases arising from desire, anger, intoxication, gambling, or actions born of delusion.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious capacity, not biological lineage alone
Causation is determined by volition and awareness, not inheritance
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with the actor's state of consciousness at time of action
Restoration logic prioritizes dissolution of karmic entanglement over intergenerational liability
Consciousness alignment determines whether an act generates binding obligation
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor's consciousness was impaired due to kāma/krodha/mada/yūta/prātibhāvyakṛtam THEN liability remains with the actor regardless of familial hierarchy
IF a debt arises outside states of conscious impairment THEN it binds only the originator of the causal sequence
IF paternity is established without conscious capacity THEN filial liability does not transfer vertically
IF an act originates in delusion THEN no trans-generational obligation shall be enforced
IF restoration of integrity requires dissolution of inherited belief THEN initiate consciousness-realignment protocol for all involved parties
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating financial or moral liabilities across generations, the Supreme Court must first establish whether the act originated in a state of conscious clarity or impairment. Only acts rooted in stable awareness may generate vertical familial obligations. Otherwise, the chain of causality terminates at the individual level, preserving the integrity of both law and consciousness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that true agency lies in awareness, not biology. Since karmic consequence follows cognition, not lineage, justice must realign consciousness rather than enforce punitive outcomes. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that effects manifest only where intent was clear; hence, restoration occurs through reconnection to source-consciousness, not through imposed consequences.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process for any unresolved emotional or energetic entanglements between parent and child
Deploy Consciousness Restoration Protocol to dissolve false identification with inherited guilt or obligation
Engage Responsibility Assumption Framework to reaffirm individual sovereignty over one’s own causal stream
Activate Integrity Reintegration Sequence to restore alignment between personal dharma and societal harmony
Execute Awareness Clarification Procedure to distinguish between authentic duty and imposed cultural conditioning
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Sanatana Dharma Jurisprudence: This ruling affirms that law derives from consciousness, not convention. No intergenerational debt binds when awareness is absent. Justice serves restoration, never retribution. Dharma prevails through awakening, not punishment.
